BATCH 01

Strider · OutRun · Super Sprint
Super Hang-On · Double Dragon · Bubble Bobble · 1942

Landscape action, two different steering systems, motorcycle turbo and local co-op. These seven give us the foundations for a much larger arcade.

    Before a game becomes playable

    Check the exact original revision, all controls, attract and start screens, sustained gameplay, audio, continues, game over, high scores, intermissions and endings. Keep original board timing and slowdown. If the browser cannot deliver it faithfully, leave it out of the launch count.

    03 / THE NEXT FRONTIER

    The 3D research shelf.

    Later cabinet hardware needs a proven browser runtime of its own. These favourites stay outside the 51-title roster until their original arcade editions pass the same browser checks.

    A Dreamcast browser port is worth exploring, but it does not establish compatibility with original NAOMI arcade games. No native launcher or console edition is part of this plan.
